card_title: Artist Notes: Volumizing Peptide Lip Plumper
summary: Non-invasive lip augmentation. A high-shine serum that visibly expands lip volume while smoothing fine lines.
description: Scientific cellular swelling. This formula bypasses traditional irritants, utilizing a biomimetic peptide complex to safely draw hyaluronic acid and moisture to the lips, resulting in profound, lasting volume.
technical_overview: Offered at $26.0 for 4ml, this KoColor LIP_PLUMPER is expertly formulated with Polybutene, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, and Menthol. It delivers a high-fidelity High-Shine Clear color profile (`#FFFFFF`) and leverages vasodilation and peptide stimulation.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Apply generously to bare lips and wait 3-5 minutes for the activation phase to peak.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Use as a prep mask at the beginning of your routine; wipe off the excess before applying your final lip color for a smooth, plumped canvas.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Menthol initiates immediate micro-circulation, while the tripeptide ensures long-term structural collagen support.
